_comment: Feature tracking file for Xavier — root-level summary. Full detail in .gitcore/features.json

metadata.reconciliation_notes: Root-level summary. See .gitcore/features.json for full details.

features.name: Unified SQLite Storage
features.description: Unified durable storage using SQLite + SQLite-vec for vectors, graph data, and memory persistence

features.name: BM25 + Vector Hybrid Search
features.description: Hybrid Search combining BM25 keyword matching and vector retrieval with RRF merging

features.name: Belief Graph
features.description: Belief Graph for conceptual relationship mapping and cognitive inference

features.name: MCP Server
features.description: HTTP-first integration with optional Model Context Protocol (MCP) support exposing 12 tools

features.name: Code Graph Index
features.description: AST-backed code indexing and symbol search through code-graph sidecar crate with MCP structural tools

features.name: Session Management
features.description: Session persistence, authentication, and context management for AI agent interactions

features.name: Encryption at Rest
features.description: AES-256-GCM encryption for stored memory data with Argon2 key derivation

features.name: Starlight Documentation Site
features.description: Astro + Starlight documentation site for Xavier public-facing docs

features.name: SRC Reference Documentation
features.description: Source Code Reference (SRC) — comprehensive documentation per GitCore protocol

features.name: Xavier Mesh P2P Network & Data Commons
features.description: Distributed P2P memory synchronization with encrypted telemetry, Ed25519 identity, ACL, and Data Commons

features.name: Telegram Bot Integration
features.description: Telegram bot for receiving commands and sending notifications from Xavier

features.name: Notification Persistence and Delivery
features.description: Persistent notification system with event bus, SQLite storage, REST API, and Tauri real-time updates

features.name: HORMER Hierarchical Navigation
features.description: Hierarchical memory navigation with RL policy, Textual Gradient Descent, and GRPO optimization

features.name: Bicameral Governance DAO
features.description: Bicameral governance system with weighted voting, veto, XIP lifecycle, and on-chain integration

features.name: Runtime Health & Self-Monitoring
features.description: Native runtime loop for system health, database integrity, embedding providers, and auto-benchmarks

features.name: Auto-Improvement Loop
features.description: Closed-loop auto-improvement: benchmark → gap analysis → generate experiment → validate → merge → re-measure

features.name: Dual License (AGPL + Commercial)
features.description: AGPL-3.0 for standalone use; Commercial/Mesh License for network participation and enterprise features

features.name: Context Regeneration & Perfect Recall
features.description: Continuous context regeneration using real usage data to drive recall@k toward 100%

features.name: OpenClaw Agent Scanner
features.description: Scans clawd/agents/ directories for OpenClaw agent memory files (MEMORY.md, SOUL.md, etc.)

features.name: Xavier Agent CLI Commands
features.description: CLI commands: xavier agent scan/index/push/pull/status/sync for managing OpenClaw agent memory
